profileLabel: Center-left economics (medium confidence); no other dimension scored
summary: Negros Occidental 5th District representative with 53 principal-authored bills. Authored free epoetin for indigent patients, free health benefits for uniformed personnel, an anti-rabies center per congressional district, freelance worker protection, enhanced senior and PWD discounts, an amended sugar Social Amelioration Program, bank transparency and a national cybersecurity framework, plus several new court branches.
caveat: Bank transparency and cybersecurity are single issues and not scored. Court-branch bills are administrative. Bill-based only.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored free epoetin for indigent patients and free health benefits for uniformed personnel (-3), freelance worker protection (-2), enhanced senior and PWD discounts (-2) and a revised sugar social amelioration program (-2). Four issues, bill-based.
